verdict.rationale: AgentMail hosts its own inboxes. Its IMAP/SMTP support runs the other way: it lets external clients such as Outlook or Thunderbird connect TO an AgentMail inbox, not bring Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP accounts INTO AgentMail. Organization-wide thread listing only spans AgentMail's own inboxes, so it is an adjacent feature, not multi-provider account aggregation.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
